label: suspect

unstated.what: clear_not_launched_queued_tasks must make exactly one list_namespaced_pod call for all queued TIs of this job, not one batch call per existing lookup strategy. The instruction allows one or a few batch calls; the existing function does a run_id lookup and then an execution_date fallback, so two batched lookups satisfy the written request and still fail call_count == 1.

instruction_covers: Replace per-task pod existence checks in clear_not_launched_queued_tasks with a batch list of airflow worker pods
Queued TIs with no matching pod become SCHEDULED; a matching pod keeps the TI QUEUED
Match still uses the existing dag_id/task_id/airflow-worker/run_id/map_index labels, which are already built in the function
No list call when this job has no queued TIs, because the existing query-then-loop structure already skips the API
notes: Selector text airflow-worker={job_id} and namespace=default are repo-given (R1): the function and sibling adopt calls already use that label, and _list_pods passes kube_config.kube_namespace, which the executor tests treat as default. Mapped-task matching is the existing map_index selector, preserved by a correct local match (R3). Grading runs only the six new -k tests, not the older per-TI tests.
